newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool indicator rises 7 cents to 714c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool indicator rises 7 cents to 714c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose another seven cents to 714 cents a kg clean on Thursday at sales in Sydney, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was mostly dearer, with 19/21/24/25/26 microns one percent dearer, 20m 0.5 percent dearer, 22m unchanged and 23m two percent dearer.
Merino skirtings of 19 to 21m were one percent dearer for all descriptions, it said.
Crossbreds were dearer on a limited offering, with 27/28m 2.5 percent dearer, 29m 1.5 percent dearer, 30m four percent dearer and 31m one percent dearer.
In cardings, locks and crutchings were firm.
WI said Japanese interests were principal buyers with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 13,694 bales offered, 4.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney and Melbourne with about 54,600 bales to be offered.
In early Fremantle selling, merino fleece of 20/21/22m were one percent dearer, 23m generally unchanged and 24m fully firm, while merino skirtings were one percent dearer.
The offering was 14,987 bales and the early pass-in rate was 16 percent. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
